description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade functions for MikroTik devices within the OpenWrt project. It defines methods for checking the image, performing upgrades on NAND devices, and a general upgrade method that determines device type and proceeds accordingly.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Returns success unconditionally, indicating the image is valid.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_mikrotik_nand
methods.description: Handles the upgrade process for MikroTik devices using NAND storage by extracting kernel from the upgrade image and writing it to the appropriate partition, then performing a NAND-specific upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Determines device model and decides whether to call the NAND upgrade method or perform a default upgrade after erasing firmware if booted from initramfs.
